root_causes.description: Frontend service experiencing significant memory pressure (z+5.90, the highest resource anomaly across all services) causing error rate spike (z>1000) and latency degradation (p99_latency_ms z+388.16), likely due to resource contention or memory leak; this frontend-specific memory anomaly differentiates it from shipping which has error/latency anomalies but not comparable memory pressure

Shipping service shows error_rate z>1000 and p99_latency_ms z>1000 anomalies; frontend depends on shipping per topology, so shipping failures may propagate errors and latency to frontend, though shipping lacks the frontend-specific memory anomaly (z+1.18 vs z+5.90)

Checkout service shows p99_latency_ms z+541.33 anomaly; frontend depends on checkout per topology, so checkout latency degradation propagates downstream contributing to frontend's latency symptoms, though checkout shows no comparable error_rate or memory anomalies

remediation_steps: Investigate frontend pod for memory leak or resource exhaustion; check OOM events and GC logs
Increase frontend memory limit or optimize application memory footprint
Review shipping service for error sources and latency bottlenecks
Monitor frontend memory and error rates post-intervention for resolution
